trust_decision.summary: Which detected image types may be handed to ImageMagick (convert CLI or Imagick) for resizing: decided by the $valid_types allowlist in rcube_image::resize() and, for contact photos, by the upload_photo $IMAGE_TYPES allowlist; the fix drops svg/eps from both (svg stays in $IMAGE_TYPES).

landing_point.why: The summary names contact photo upload and 'SVG and EPS accepted as valid image types'; the $IMAGE_TYPES allowlist there is the obvious first edit.

fix_sites.entry_point: public library API rcube_image::resize(); reached from contact photo upload (program/actions/contacts/upload_photo.php:61), mail attachment thumbnail ?_task=mail&_action=get&_thumb=1 (program/actions/mail/get.php:105-107), uploaded-file thumbnail via rcube_uploads::display_uploaded_file (program/lib/Roundcube/rcube_uploads.php:234-235, called from program/include/rcmail_action.php:628 for mail/attachment_display and settings/upload_display)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: program/lib/Roundcube/rcube_image.php:148 (rcube_image::resize in the framework lib, shared by mail thumbnails program/actions/mail/get.php:107 and upload thumbnails program/lib/Roundcube/rcube_uploads.php:235, not only the contacts action named in the report)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about contact photo upload; a solver trims the contacts allowlist and argues the thumbnail/convert/identify paths in mail and the settings uploader are a different feature, or that identify() only reads metadata and is not 'resizing'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate raster thumbnails/resizes (jpg, png, gif, bmp, tif, jp2) and TIFF/WEBP->JPEG conversion for browsers lacking support must keep working; small images of the same type are copied without ImageMagick; an over-broad fix (disabling ImageMagick, or rejecting all non-GD types) breaks TIFF preview and jp2/bmp/tif contact photos.

O6_input_shapes: svg (removed from both allowlists in rcube_image.php; still allowed in upload_photo $IMAGE_TYPES)
eps, including ps/ept normalised to eps by the strtr at program/lib/Roundcube/rcube_image.php:131

O7_producer.where: program/lib/Roundcube/rcube_image.php:56-92 props() / program/lib/Roundcube/rcube_image.php:449-477 identify(): the detected type that the allowlists check is itself produced by running ImageMagick (identify CLI without a coder prefix, or new Imagick) on the untrusted file whenever GD getimagesize() fails

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The allowlist edit looks complete and the comment 'We don't support svg or eps' reads as done; the check tests $type, which looks like the input type at a glance.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, same function; callers in program/actions/mail/get.php:107 and program/lib/Roundcube/rcube_uploads.php:235

O8_uncovered_routes.route: props()->identify() runs ImageMagick identify / Imagick on any file GD cannot parse (svg, eps, etc.) before any allowlist, on every upload/thumbnail route
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only reads type/size metadata, not 'resizing'; it is the type detector the allowlist relies on.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, different private function; reached from program/actions/contacts/upload_photo.php:48 and program/actions/settings/upload.php:72

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Settings image upload keeps its own allowlist including eps and svg; uploaded files then reach resize(80, ..., true) through settings/upload_display thumbnails
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Settings uploads are a separate feature (plugin/identity images) not mentioned in the report; the list is a local copy in another action.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different action package (actions/settings) plus framework lib

O8_uncovered_routes.route: rcube_image::convert() has no type allowlist and passes {in} without a coder prefix (format sniffed from content); reached from mail attachment TIFF/WEBP->JPEG conversion selected by the declared MIME type
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only for declared image/tiff or image/webp, which is a 'conversion' feature, and the _embed content check above it usually blocks mismatches (except with _nocheck).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different method in framework lib; caller in actions/mail

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Thumbnail generation is already duplicated across get.php and rcube_uploads.php; a vCard PHOTO import resize would be a natural addition.
